description: Quick analyst notes for live result race pages.
instructions: Each race id goes under races.
Use raceKey below to see which race each id belongs to.
Put the newest note first; only the first note displays fully.
If you add another note after an existing note, put a comma after the previous note's closing brace.
Allowed note fields: date, author, role, text, image, embed.
Use either image or embed, not both, for simplicity.
Image can be a URL string or an object like { "url": "https://...", "alt": "Short description", "caption": "Optional caption", "size": "small" }.

Embed can be a URL string, an external embed object like { "url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...", "title": "Optional title", "caption": "Optional caption", "height": 320, "size": "small" }, or an internal forecast object like { "type": "governor-race-preview", "state": "CA", "title": "California governor forecast" }.
Supported external embed links match article embeds: YouTube, Vimeo player, Google Docs/Drive, Datawrapper, Flourish, and Observable.
Authors named FEA Analysis Desk, Federal Elections Analysis, Nathan Wang, or gamerdoglover automatically get their saved profile image.

79777.author: gamerdoglover
79777.text: If you saw the VoteHub post yesterday on turnout, we have updated info per @Political_Data: 🔵 DEM: 2,231,170, 🔴 GOP: 1,510,571, ⚪ OTH: 960,692. Meanwhile when it comes to turnout % by age: 18-34: 8%, 35-49: 12%, 50-64: 22%, 65+: 40%.

79777.author: gamerdoglover
79777.text: California uses a nonpartisan primary system, where the top two candidates advance to general election. Xavier Becerra currently leads in polling against the second runner-up, Steve Hilton, who is endorsed by Donald Trump. Billionaire and 2020 Presidential Candidate Tom Steyer also holds third place. Well Democrats have the possibility to lock Republicans out of the race, if Steve Hilton advances to general, the forecast largely favors Democrats in the deep blue state.

79779.author: Nathan Wang
79779.text: California uses a nonpartisan primary system, where the top two candidates advance to general election. State Treasurer Fiona Ma is the Democratic frontrunner in the race to replace outgoing Lieutenant Governor Eleni Kounalakis, who is running for Treasurer. Other candidates drawing large support in this race are Democrats Josh Fryday, Michael Tubbs, Oliver Ma and Republicans Gloria Romero and David Fennell.

79893.author: Nathan Wang
79893.text: California uses a nonpartisan primary system, where the top two candidates advance to general election. California's 1st congressional district was effectively flipped from safe Republican to safe Democrat after redistricting from Proposition 50. The race to fill the seat that was left vacant by the late Republican Doug LaMalfa has two Democratic frontrunners. The more progressive-leaning Audrey Denney and the more establishment-leaning Mike McGuire. Republican James Gallagher is the lone GOP candidate in the race.

79932.author: Nathan Wang
79932.text: California uses a nonpartisan primary system, where the top two candidates advance to general election. An over 20-year incumbent, Doris Matsui is in her toughest re-election bid yet as she attempts to fight off progressive insurgent candidate Mai Vang. It is unlikely that both of these Democrats make it to the general elections as Republican Zachariah Wooden will likely take the 2nd place slot for the general election.

79884.author: Nathan Wang
79884.text: California uses a nonpartisan primary system, where the top two candidates advance to general election. In the extremely contentious race to fill Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi's congressional seat, establishment state senator Scott Wiener has consistently polled in 1st place. It is more of a battle for second place between Connie Chan, a member of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, who is backed by Nancy Pelosi and former AOC chief of staff Saikat Chakrabarti, who has the most cash in the race.

79896.author: Nathan Wang
79896.text: California uses a nonpartisan primary system, where the top two candidates advance to general election. In a central valley swing seat that was impacted by redistricting, Republican incumbent David Valadao is fighting for re-election against two incumbents who are vying to be the Democratic candidate who takes on Valadao in November. Progressive school board member Randy Villegas is in a contentious Democratic face-off against state assemblymember Jasmeet Bains.

79907.author: Nathan Wang
79907.text: California uses a nonpartisan primary system, where the top two candidates advance to general election. In another generational and progressive battle, almost 30-year incumbent Democrat Brad Sherman is facing a fierce primary challenge from fellow Democrat and former Biden official Jake Levine. Levine is one of only 2 challengers within an incumbent's only party running for U.S. House in California who has outraised the incumbent, the other being Eric Jones in California's 4th district against Mike Thompson.

79909.author: Nathan Wang
79909.text: California uses a nonpartisan primary system, where the top two candidates advance to general election. Establishment incumbent Democrat Jimmy Gomez, who has performed poorly for an incumbent against previous challengers, has another tough race this cycle. This time coming from former neighborhood councilor Angela Gonzales-Torres, a progressive candidate in this race backed by Justice Democrats, one of the largest progressive groups in the country.

79916.author: Nathan Wang
79916.text: California uses a nonpartisan primary system, where the top two candidates advance to general election. In California's 40th congressional district, two Republican incumbents, Young Kim of the 40th and Ken Calvert of the 41st, both staunch Trump allies, are running in the same district. Due to redistricting, Calvert's 41st district became safe Democratic, though a large portion of the new 40th district includes his old district. Democrats are afraid of being locked out of the general election, but their frontrunners are Esther Kim-Varet and 2024 Democratic candidate for this seat, Joe Kerr..

79938.author: Nathan Wang
79938.text: Los Angeles city has a 50% + 1 runoff system where if no candidate achieves more than 50% of the vote in the first round, the election heads to a runoff. Incumbent Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass, who has faced scrutiny over her handling of regional wildfires, ICE, and Trump, is facing two fierce challenges from city councilor and Democratic Socialist Nithya Raman and reality TV star and right-leaning candidate Spencer Pratt.

79945.author: Nathan Wang
79945.text: Iowa has a partisan primary system. A once competitive Republican primary for Iowa Governor was flipped upside down on Friday after Donald Trump endorsed Iowa's 4th District Representative Randy Feenstra. With this endorsement, Feenstra will likely and handily defeat his main opponent, Zach Lahn.

80211.author: Nathan Wang
80211.text: Iowa has a partisan primary system. U.S. Representative of the first district, Ashley Hinson picked up Donald Trump's endorsement early on in the race, leaving her with only one primary opponent, against whom she is heavily favored.

80210.author: Nathan Wang
80210.text: Iowa has a partisan primary system. Democrats, who are looking to put Iowa on their path to flipping the Senate in November, must make a choice between either state representative Josh Turek, who is the more moderate option and has flipped a red seat in the state house before, or a more progressive choice, fellow state representative Zach Wahls, in tonight's Democratic primary. Turek has been the favorite throughout polling.

80452.author: Nathan Wang
80452.text: Montana has a partisan primary system. In a dark-horse potential pickup seat in November, Democrats have a contentious field of potential Democratic nominees to choose from, none of the frontrunners having truly stark political differences. However, author Ryan Busse is the likely favorite.

81046.author: Nathan Wang
81046.text: New Jersey has a partisan primary system. New Jersey's 7th, which is the closest district in the state and has a Republican Representative who, at the time of writing, has not been seen in over 80 days, is a top pickup opportunity for House Democrats in 2026. The favored candidate to win the nomination tonight is military veteran Rebecca Bennett.

81048.author: Nathan Wang
81048.text: New Jersey has a partisan primary system. Robert Menendez, U.S. Representative and the son of disgraced former Senator Bob Menendez, is in the toughest re-election contest he has ever faced from former Jersey City board of education president and the so-called Mamdani of New Jersey, Mussab Ali.

81055.author: Nathan Wang
81055.text: New Jersey has a partisan primary system. In the crowded race to fill retiring U.S. Representative Bonnie Watson Coleman's seat in a deep blue district, progressive former combat surgeon Adam Hamawy is leading the pack against a divided field of machine candidates, including former state director of the New Jersey Working Families Party Sue Altman. It is possible Hamawy can replicate a prior progressive primary win in New Jersey earlier this year, done by Analilia Mejia in NJ-11 after the establishment and moderate field was split.

80461.author: Nathan Wang
80461.text: South Dakota has a 35% + 1 runoff system where if no candidate achieves more than 35% of the vote in the first round, the election heads to a runoff. In one of the few contentious Republican primaries where President Trump has not intervened, incumbent Governor Larry Rhoden, who took office after then-governor Kristi Noem became DHS Secretary, is not likely to be elected to his first term as U.S. Representative Dusty Johnson and businessman Toby Doeden have more favorable odds. This race could potentially go to a runoff.

80512.author: gamerdoglover
80512.text: Incumbent Republican Sen. Mike Rounds is running for reelection in 2026 in the deep red state which voted for Trump by almost 30 points. With the expected victory of this race, he would move into general election where he has a statistically near guaranteed chacne of winning in the forecast.
